entities.summary: Daphne Margaret Sybil Désirée Park, Baroness Park of Monmouth CMG OBE FRSA was a British intelligence officer, diplomat and public servant. During her career as a clandestine senior controller in MI6 (1943–1993) she was stationed in Austria (1946-1948), Moscow (1954–1956), the Congo (1959–1961), Zambia (1964–1967) and Hanoi (1969–1971).
